messages.body_plain:
Good morning,

I'm a student and I can't open Rkward. After installing it, an error pops
up telling me if I want to recover a crash file, but when I click on any
option, the app instantly crashes. I'm desperate. I left attached a copy of
the error my computer gives me when the app crashes.

Thank you very much
